mapper.select: SELECT user_id as userId, nickname, user_name as name, email, DATE_FORMAT(birth_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as birthDate, gender, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as joinedAt, profile_image as profileImage FROM USER WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ubr.intimacy_id AS level, ubr.current_exp AS remainPoint, b.bot_id AS botId, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(b.display_name), ''), b.name) AS botName, b.avatar_image AS botAvatarImage, ubr.last_feed_reward_at AS lastFeedRewardAt FROM USER u INNER JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON e.user_id = u.user_id AND e.bot_id = COALESCE( ( SELECT e0.bot_id FROM EXCLUSIVE e0 INNER JOIN USER u0 ON u0.user_id = #{userId} AND u0.user_id = e0.user_id WHERE e0.bot_id = u0.assigned_bot_id LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT e1.bot_id FROM EXCLUSIVE e1 WHERE e1.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e1.exclusive_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) INNER JOIN USER_BOT_RELATION ubr ON ubr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id INNER JOIN BOT b ON b.bot_id = e.bot_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT bot_id AS botId, name, display_name AS displayName, avatar_image AS avatarImage FROM BOT ORDER BY bot_id ASC
SELECT bot_id AS botId, name, display_name AS displayName, avatar_image AS avatarImage, card_stats_json AS cardStatsJson FROM BOT ORDER BY bot_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOT WHERE bot_id = #{botId}
SELECT bot_id FROM BOT ORDER BY bot_id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT exclusive_id FROM EXCLUSIVE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND bot_id = #{botId} ORDER BY exclusive_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_BOT_RELATION (exclusive_id, intimacy_id, current_exp) VALUES (#{exclusiveId}, #{intimacyId}, #{currentExp})
mapper.select: SELECT background_id AS backgroundId, name, image_url AS imageUrl, CASE WHEN unlock_intimacy_level > #{userLevel} THEN '잠금' ELSE '보유' END AS state FROM CHAT_BACKGROUND ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT motion_code as motionCode, motion_name as name, asset_url as assetUrl, unlock_intimacy_level as unlockIntimacyLevel, CASE WHEN unlock_intimacy_level > #{userLevel} THEN '잠금' WHEN motion_group = 'COMMON' THEN '기본' ELSE '보유' END as tag FROM BOT_MOTION WHERE bot_id = COALESCE( ( SELECT e0.bot_id FROM EXCLUSIVE e0 INNER JOIN USER u0 ON u0.user_id = #{userId} AND u0.user_id = e0.user_id WHERE e0.bot_id = u0.assigned_bot_id LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT e1.bot_id FROM EXCLUSIVE e1 WHERE e1.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e1.exclusive_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN unlock_intimacy_level > #{userLevel} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, motion_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOT_LETTER bl JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON bl.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND bl.is_read = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOT_LETTER bl JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON bl.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND bl.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

SELECT bl.letter_id as id, blt.name as type, '메이티' as sender, bl.title, bl.content as preview, bl.content as content, CASE WHEN DATE(bl.created_at) = CURDATE() THEN '오늘' WHEN DATE(bl.created_at) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN '어제' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(bl.created_at)) < 7 THEN CONCAT(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(bl.created_at)), '일 전') ELSE CONCAT(FLOOR(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(bl.created_at)) / 7), '주 전') END as date, NOT bl.is_read as unread FROM BOT_LETTER bl JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON bl.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id JOIN BOT_LETTER_TYPE blt ON bl.letter_type_id = blt.letter_type_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY bl.created_at DESC

SELECT cs.counsel_id FROM COUNSEL_SUMMARY cs JOIN CHAT_ROOM cr ON cs.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON cr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cs.counsel_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT b.name AS "botName", u.nickname AS "userNickname", /* 해당 사용자가 이 봇과 나눈 상담 총 횟수 (첫 상담 여부 판단용) */ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUNSEL_SUMMARY cs2 JOIN CHAT_ROOM cr2 ON cs2.chat_room_id = cr2.chat_room_id JOIN EXCLUSIVE e2 ON cr2.exclusive_id = e2.exclusive_id WHERE e2.user_id = u.user_id AND e2.bot_id = b.bot_id) AS "counselCount", m.risk_level AS "riskLevel", cs.content AS "content" FROM COUNSEL_SUMMARY cs JOIN CHAT_ROOM cr ON cs.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON cr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id JOIN BOT b ON e.bot_id = b.bot_id JOIN USER u ON e.user_id = u.user_id JOIN MESSAGE m ON cs.end_message_id = m.message_id WHERE cs.counsel_id = #{counselId}

SELECT COALESCE(us.bot_letter_enabled, 1) as pushNotice, COALESCE(us.satisfaction_popup_enabled, 1) as satisfactionPopup, COALESCE(u.is_marketing_agreed, 1) as marketingNotice, COALESCE(us.casual_mode_enabled, 0) as casualTone, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'BOT_MESSAGE'), 1) as noti_bot_message, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'CHAT_REMINDER'), 1) as noti_chat_reminder, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'COMMENT_REPLY'), 1) as noti_comment_reply, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'COMMUNITY_HOT'), 1) as noti_community_hot, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'EVENT_NOTICE'), 1) as noti_event_notice, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'POINT_REWARD'), 1) as noti_point_reward, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'POST_COMMENT'), 1) as noti_post_comment, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'REPORT_RESULT'), 1) as noti_report_result, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'SUPPORT_ANSWER'), 1) as noti_support_answer, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'SYSTEM_NOTICE'), 1) as noti_system_notice FROM USER u LEFT JOIN USER_SETTING us ON us.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}

choose.otherwise:
UPDATE USER_SETTING
bot_letter_enabled = #{value}, satisfaction_popup_enabled = #{value}, casual_mode_enabled = #{value},
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE user_id = #{userId}

mapper.select: SELECT ubr.intimacy_id AS level, ubr.current_exp AS exp, ubr.last_feed_reward_at AS lastFeedRewardAt FROM USER_BOT_RELATION ubr JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON ubr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.bot_id = COALESCE( ( SELECT e0.bot_id FROM EXCLUSIVE e0 INNER JOIN USER u0 ON u0.user_id = #{userId} AND u0.user_id = e0.user_id WHERE e0.bot_id = u0.assigned_bot_id LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT e1.bot_id FROM EXCLUSIVE e1 WHERE e1.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e1.exclusive_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_BOT_RELATION ubr JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON ubr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id SET ubr.last_feed_reward_at = NOW() WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.bot_id = COALESCE( ( SELECT e0.bot_id FROM EXCLUSIVE e0 INNER JOIN USER u0 ON u0.user_id = #{userId} AND u0.user_id = e0.user_id WHERE e0.bot_id = u0.assigned_bot_id LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT e1.bot_id FROM EXCLUSIVE e1 WHERE e1.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e1.exclusive_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOT_LETTER (letter_type_id, exclusive_id, title, content, is_read) SELECT #{letterTypeId}, e.exclusive_id, #{title}, #{content}, FALSE FROM EXCLUSIVE e JOIN USER u ON u.user_id = e.user_id AND u.user_id = #{userId} WHERE e.bot_id = COALESCE( ( SELECT e0.bot_id FROM EXCLUSIVE e0 INNER JOIN USER u0 ON u0.user_id = #{userId} AND u0.user_id = e0.user_id WHERE e0.bot_id = u0.assigned_bot_id LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT e1.bot_id FROM EXCLUSIVE e1 WHERE e1.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e1.exclusive_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO BOT_LETTER (letter_type_id, exclusive_id, title, content, is_read) VALUES (#{letterTypeId}, #{exclusiveId}, #{title}, #{content}, FALSE)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id FROM USER u JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON e.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN USER_SETTING us ON us.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(us.bot_letter_enabled, TRUE) = TRUE AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), u.last_login_at) BETWEEN #{minDays} AND #{maxDays}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(b.display_name), ''), b.name) AS botName, u.nickname AS userNickname FROM USER u LEFT JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON e.user_id = u.user_id AND e.bot_id = COALESCE( (SELECT e0.bot_id FROM EXCLUSIVE e0 INNER JOIN USER u0 ON u0.user_id = #{userId} AND u0.user_id = e0.user_id WHERE e0.bot_id = u0.assigned_bot_id LIMIT 1), (SELECT e1.bot_id FROM EXCLUSIVE e1 WHERE e1.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e1.exclusive_id ASC LIMIT 1) ) LEFT JOIN BOT b ON b.bot_id = e.bot_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOT_LETTER bl JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON bl.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND bl.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR)
